included.title: Complete Online Store
included.desc: Fully responsive store built for mobile, tablet, and desktop, with a clean, modern design.

included.desc: Professional product pages, with support for multiple colors and sizes per product.

included.title: Wishlist
included.desc: Customers can save products they like — no login or signup needed.

included.title: Simple Cart & One-Page Checkout
included.desc: Just name, contact, and address to complete an order — no account required, so fewer customers drop off.

included.title: Instant WhatsApp Order Alerts
included.desc: You and your customer both get an automatic order confirmation on WhatsApp the moment an order is placed.

included.title: Secure Online Payments
included.desc: Accept UPI, cards, and net banking safely through a trusted payment gateway.

included.title: Admin Dashboard
included.desc: See every order in one place and update order status as you fulfill them.

included.desc: Manage delivery charge, return policy, and refund policy yourself from the admin panel — the storefront picks up the changes automatically.

included.title: Sales & Revenue Report
included.desc: See your total revenue, total orders, and average order value at a glance, with a day-by-day breakdown you can export to CSV anytime.

included.title: Product & Category Management
included.desc: Add, edit, or remove products, variants, and stock levels anytime — no developer needed.

included.title: Easy Content Updates
included.desc: Change your homepage text, images, and product descriptions yourself, whenever you want.

alsoIncluded.title: Free SSL Security

alsoIncluded.title: SEO Ready
alsoIncluded.desc: Set up to get found on Google — proper page titles, clean links, and a sitemap.

alsoIncluded.desc: Content structured so AI tools like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews can find and recommend your store.

alsoIncluded.title: No Login Needed for Customers
alsoIncluded.desc: Faster checkout, nothing to sign up for — less friction, more completed sales.

alsoIncluded.title: Live Walkthrough Call
alsoIncluded.desc: We personally walk you through managing your orders, products, and store — no guesswork.

alsoIncluded.title: 3 Months Free Bug Support

included.desc: Beyond the main dashboard, each module — orders, products, customers, and more — gets its own overview page with the stats that matter specifically for it.

included.title: Blog / Content Section
included.desc: Publish articles and updates that help you rank higher on Google over time.

included.title: Priority Support — 6 Months Free Bug Fixes
included.desc: Double the standard support window, plus faster response times.
